#!/bin/bash
# Count distinct Go packages outside store/ that reference each entity type

REPO="/bench/repo"
ENTITY_TYPES=(
  "User"
  "Memo"
  "Attachment"
  "IdentityProvider"
  "Inbox"
  "InstanceSetting"
  "MemoRelation"
  "MemoShare"
  "Reaction"
  "UserIdentity"
  "UserSetting"
  "AuthenticationConfigState"
  "Role"
  "Visibility"
  "RowStatus"
  "InboxStatus"
  "MemoRelationType"
)

for entity in "${ENTITY_TYPES[@]}"; do
  # Find files outside store/ that reference store.Entity or *store.Entity
  files=$(grep -rl "store\.$entity\b\|store\.\*$entity\b" "$REPO" --include="*.go" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^$REPO/store/")
  
  # Extract unique packages (directories containing go files)
  packages=$(echo "$files" | while read f; do
    if [ -n "$f" ]; then
      dirname "$f"
    fi
  done | sort -u)
  
  count=$(echo "$packages" | grep -c . 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  if [ "$count" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "=== $entity: $count packages ==="
    echo "$packages"
    echo
  fi
done
SCRIPT

#!/bin/bash

# Get Go package path from file
get_pkg() {
  local f="$1"
  # Use directory relative to repo as package identifier
  echo "$f" | sed "s|$REPO/||" | xargs dirname
}

count_entity() {
  local pattern="$1"
  local name="$2"
  local exclude="$3"
  
  files=$(grep -rl "$pattern" "$REPO" --include="*.go" 2>/dev/null | \
    grep -v "^$REPO/store/" | \
    grep -v "^$REPO/proto/gen/store/" | \
    grep -v "_test.go" || true)
  
  if [ -n "$exclude" ]; then
    files=$(echo "$files" | grep -v "$exclude" || true)
  fi
  
  packages=$(echo "$files" | while read f; do
    [ -n "$f" ] && get_pkg "$f"
  done | sort -u)
  
  count=$(echo "$packages" | grep -c . 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  echo "$name|$count"
  echo "$packages" | sed 's/^/  /'
  echo
}

echo "=== Store entity structs (store.Type) ==="
